full_name: David R. Nelson | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Biological Sciences Shutzer Fellow Harvard University
bio: David R. Nelson is the Arthur K. Solomon Professor of Biophysics and a professor of physics and applied physics at Harvard University. With his colleague Bertrand I. Halperin, he is responsible for a theory of two-dimensional melting that predicts a fourth, “hexatic” phase of matter, interposed between the usual solid and liquid phases.
